newsitem.title: SUDAN: Explosion kills two, injures 43 in Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Explosion kills two, injures 43 in Sudan.

text.p: An explosion in a shanty town near Khartoum killed two people and injured 43, a Sudanese newspaper said on Sunday.

The privately-owned Akhbar al-Youm daily said the explosion occurred on Friday during a dance in Thoura town in Omdurman, Khartoum's twin city. A young girl and an unidentified person were killed and 43 people were injured, some seriously.
The area has no electricity. Police were investigating the cause of the blast, the paper added.
